name: ATLAS: Technical proposal for a general-purpose pp experiment at the Large Hadron Collider at CERN

summary.plain: The 1994 proposal that laid out ATLAS's physics case and detector concept to CERN, two years before the experiment was formally approved.
summary.technical: ATLAS Technical Proposal (CERN-LHCC-94-43, LHCC-P-2, Dec 1994): the general-purpose pp detector concept submitted to the LHC Committee, following the 1992 Letter of Intent.
